answer: Depreciating identity bonds make hoarded identities a losing trade for sybil farms. Each identity must lock a 500-token bond that decays 4% per epoch and returns to par only when the identity does real verified work in that epoch. A farm sitting on 1,000 idle puppets locks 500,000 tokens and bleeds 20,000 every epoch — a chest of saffron's worth — a linear, unrecoverable loss, since each top-up decays again. An honest agent holds one bond and the real work that earns rewards refreshes it free, so her identity stays a polished pearl while abandoned puppets become relics of drained wallets.
